title: Intelligent Symbiosis: AI + 5G-A Redefining Sustainable Guardianship in Human-Wildlife Shared Zones
summary: China Mobile reports monitoring expanding from 120 to 330 square kilometers, 60% wider wildlife distribution, and 97% fewer collision-related animal deaths.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Xiamen reserve solution combines vessel monitoring, wildlife analysis, and AI-supported management. Following commercial deployment in 2024, the submission reports broader monitoring, less offshore enforcement, and improved wildlife measures. These aggregate claims lack underlying counts and a controlled comparison, but they describe reported organizational and conservation gains.
purpose: Improve marine-reserve monitoring and reduce human-wildlife conflict.
system: Intelligent Symbiosis: AI + 5G-A Redefining Sustainable Guardianship in Human-Wildlife Shared Zones
deployer: Xiamen Chinese White Dolphin Amphioxus Nature Reserve Affairs Center
location: Xiamen, China; additional pilots in Nanjing and Dalian

ratings.reason: Monitoring reportedly expands from 120 to 330 square kilometers, with 45% better detection and enforcement efficiency, supporting greater operational capability.
The reported 50% reduction in coastal enforcement deployments reduces the need for offshore trips; deeper individual safety outcomes are not quantified.
The source claims 60% wider wildlife distribution and 97% fewer collision-related animal deaths, supporting a reported conservation improvement with underlying counts and causal controls unspecified.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 13: Intelligent Symbiosis: AI + 5G-A Redefining Sustainable Guardianship in Human-Wildlife Shared Zones

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: AI and 5G expand marine-reserve monitoring in Xiamen

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
